title: pi-vcc Configuration
description: Configuration for pi-vcc algorithmic conversation compactor

overrideDefaultCompaction.description: When true, pi-vcc handles ALL compactions (/compact, auto-threshold, /pi-vcc). When false, only /pi-vcc triggers pi-vcc; everything else falls back to pi core's LLM-based compaction.

debug.description: Write debug snapshot to /tmp/pi-vcc-debug.json on each compaction.

extraction.description: Fine-grained extraction configuration. All extra* patterns are ADDITIVE — built-in patterns are never removed.

references.description: References extractor: URLs, GitHub refs, versions, branches, commit refs. Output appears as [References] section.

enabled.description: When false, skip this extraction entirely.

extraUrlPatterns.description: Additional URL regex patterns (appended to built-in https?://\S+). Each pattern is compiled with global flag. Capture group 1 or full match is used.

extraGithubRefPatterns.description: Additional GitHub ref patterns (appended to built-in #\d+, PR\s*#\d+, owner/repo). Full match is used.

extraVersionPatterns.description: Additional version patterns (appended to built-in v?\d+\.\d+\.\d+). Capture group 1 or full match is used.

extraBranchPatterns.description: Additional branch patterns (appended to built-in feat|fix|hotfix|release|.../xxx). Full match is used.

keySignals.description: Key Signals extractor: constraints, decisions, status markers. Output appears as [Key Signals] section.

enabled.description: When false, skip this extraction entirely.

extraConstraintPatterns.description: Additional constraint patterns (appended to built-in don't|must not|cannot|forbidden|disallowed|off-limits|out of scope|excluded|do not). Applied to user messages only.

extraDecisionPatterns.description: Additional decision patterns (appended to built-in decided|let's use|going with|chose|we'll use). Applied to user messages only.

extraStatusPatterns.description: Additional status keywords (appended to built-in DONE|TODO|WIP|blocked|resolved). Keywords are matched at sentence start or after punctuation. Applied to user + assistant messages.

goals.description: Goals extractor tweaks. Controls session goal and scope-change detection.

enabled.description: When false, skip goals extraction entirely (only affects [Session Goal] section).

extraTaskVerbs.description: Additional task verbs (appended to built-in fix|implement|add|create|build|refactor|...). Used to detect new task statements in user messages.

extraScopeChangeWords.description: Additional scope-change keywords (appended to built-in instead|actually|change of plan|...). Used to detect when user pivots to a new goal.
